component.name: APK Starter
component.summary: Run Android apps on the Linux desktop

description.p: APK Starter runs a single Android app from its APK file on the Linux desktop. It is built on Android Translation Layer (ATL) and translates the app's calls to GTK, Wayland and the usual Linux libraries instead of running a full Android system.

ul.li: Bring your own APK: open it, double-click it, or add it to the application menu.
Each app keeps its own data folder.
An optional log helps to find out why an app does not work.

description.p: No apps are included and no Google services are provided. Apps that need Google Play services, Jetpack Compose, ARM-only native code, the camera, Bluetooth or telephony may not work.
Android is a trademark of Google LLC.
